name: ICBC Turkey Bank A.S.
summary: ICBC Turkey Bank A.S., together with its subsidiaries, provides various banking products and services in Turkey. The company provides savings deposit, daily time deposit, rates, and time deposit accounts. It also offers consumer loans; and online banking, campaigns, citizenship applications, cards, payments, investment, safe deposit boxes, life insurance, and individual pension system (IPS) for individuals. In addition, it provides domestic financing, export financing, eximbank loans, foreign credit, non-cash loans, trade finance and RMB loans; and money transfer, POS and merchant services, domestic financing, risk management, investment, organization, cash management, and insurance services…
